While legendary restaurants like Arsalan, Aminia, Shiraz, and Royal Indian Hotel dominate the premium segment, there is another name that has quietly become a favorite among students, office workers, and budget-conscious food lovers—<strong>Shimla Biryani</strong>.</p><p>Over the years, Shimla Biryani has earned a reputation for serving affordable biryani without compromising too much on taste or quantity. Is it worth visiting when there are so many biryani options available in Kolkata?</p><p>In this detailed review, we'll explore everything about Shimla Biryani—from its food quality and ambience to pricing, service, cleanliness, and overall value for money.</p><h2><strong>About Shimla Biryani</strong></h2><p>Shimla Biryani is a Kolkata-based restaurant chain specializing in Mughlai and North Indian cuisine. Since its establishment in <strong>2013</strong>, the brand has focused on a simple philosophy:</p><p><strong>Serve filling, tasty biryani at prices almost everyone can afford.</strong></p><p>Instead
